channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: China’s Top Spy Chief Warns A.I. Is a Threat to Party Rule
item.description: Even as Beijing urges the United States not to hype the dangers of A.I., its own spy chief is framing the technology as a threat to the Communist Party’s security.

item.title: NPR: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
item.description: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.

item.title: BBC News: Burnham cancels engagements after death of his father
item.description: Burnham has previously said his father did not know he had become prime minister due to his Alzheimer's.

item.title: The Guardian: I worked at Google DeepMind. You should listen to the warnings about AI | Alex Turner
item.description: We must stop companies from allowing AI to self-improve into an uncontrollable level of intelligence Major AI lab CEOs advocated for slowing the pace of AI development this weekend. They are right to be concerned: the fi…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Eto’o faces allegations of embezzlement in Cameroon FA presidency role
item.description: Ex-Chelsea and Barcelona striker Samuel Eto’o faces new allegations over Cameroon FA finances under his presidency.

item.title: Ars Technica: F1 in Madrid: Like Monaco but twice as long and none of the glamour
item.description: Formula 1’s latest venue might be fun to drive, but the race was processional and dull.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: A College Girl Was Exploited on Camera. A Network of Anonymous Men Got to Work
item.description: Maddie Kowalski is one of countless young women who’ve had their lives destroyed by the burnerverse, a loosely connected online community of sports fans. Now she’s fighting back.

item.title: WIRED Science: AI Agents Are Thirsty for Power
item.description: Silicon Valley is shifting away from chatbot queries toward a future filled with resource-intensive agentic AI—and it's driving the data center buildout.

item.title: WIRED Business: AI Leaders Are Calling for a Slowdown. Trump’s Team Says It’s on Them
item.description: Sam Altman and Elon Musk backed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s weekend plea for regulation. The White House seems unlikely to oblige.

item.title: The New Yorker: The American Religion of Self-Storage Facilities
item.description: Why are we so obsessed with putting our belongings in metal boxes and then never looking at them again?

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Why Didn’t Anyone Flirt at the Dating-App Party?
item.description: We asked two bachelors at the Readme launch if they liked reading. One said, “I know how to read.”

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: A One-Bedroom With Harbor Views in Park Slope for $925,000
item.description: And a Williamsburg loft with floor-to-ceiling windows nearly 15 feet high.
